reason: Full code run with 3 files modified (chat.js, index.js, audio-playback-attack.test.mjs). Blueprints and decisions extracted directly from tool calls.

blueprints.title: TTS Speed Normalization
blueprints.summary: Changed ttsSpeed from 0.85 (A1/A2) / 0.9 (VI) / 1.0 (default) to always 1.0. Root cause: aura-2-zeus-en TTS produces choppy audio artifacts at sub-1.0 speed with MP3 encoding.

blueprints.title: Dual-Audio Prevention — Greeting Guard
blueprints.summary: Added agentGreetingSent flag. Prevents duplicate InjectAgentMessage greeting when Deepgram sends duplicate Welcome/SettingsApplied (reconnect race). Reset on agent drop.

blueprints.title: Dual-Audio Prevention — Silence Timer Guard
blueprints.summary: Added agentInjectInFlight flag. Prevents silence timer from sending encouragement inject while another inject is still being processed by Deepgram. Cleared on inject conversation text arrival, barge-in, and WS drop.

blueprints.title: Re-entrant Guard for playAgentChunk
blueprints.summary: Added guard: if (agentPlaying && agentCurrentAudio && !agentCurrentAudio.paused) return. Prevents concurrent Audio elements from playing simultaneously when playAgentChunk is called from multiple code paths.

blueprints.title: Audio Queue Cap Fix — Raised to 100
blueprints.summary: Fixed structural bug where large audio chunks bypassed queue cap check entirely (line 1523 pushed event.data without length guard). Raised cap from 30 to 100. Old cap truncated long-form responses mid-sentence. New condition structure ensures both accumulated + direct chunks get checked.

blueprints.title: Mic-Denied Detection — navigator.mediaDevices Guard
blueprints.summary: Added navigator.mediaDevices guard at start of startAgentListening(). Shows 'Mic not available in this browser' instead of silent crash in in-app browsers (Zalo, Facebook, Line).

blueprints.title: Stale Connection Timeout — Mic Click Handler
blueprints.summary: Added 12-second timeout in the WS-not-ready path of mic click handler. When agent WS connects but never becomes ready (SettingsApplied never received), status updates from 'Connecting…' to 'Connection problem — tap to try again' instead of hanging forever.

decisions.title: Always 1.0 ttsSpeed
decisions.summary: Removed all conditional speed logic. The Deepgram aura-2-zeus-en TTS engine does not benefit from reduced speed — it causes choppy MP3 encoding artifacts. Students at all levels get 1.0.
decisions.rationale: Death Seal Run 138 §9.1 — tested and confirmed choppy at 0.85.

decisions.title: Dual-audio prevented at guard level, not Deepgram level
decisions.summary: Rather than trying to detect Deepgram's internal state, added client-side guard flags (agentGreetingSent, agentInjectInFlight) to prevent duplicate/overlapping InjectAgentMessage sends.
decisions.rationale: Deepgram Voice Agent queues messages internally; once sent, cannot cancel. Client-side guards are the only reliable prevention.

decisions.title: Audio queue cap at 100, not 30
decisions.summary: Raised from 30 to 100 and restructured accumulation logic to apply cap uniformly. Previous code had two push paths and only checked the cap on one.
decisions.rationale: 30 chunks was ~3-4 seconds of audio in small-chunk mode. Deepgram sends audio in frames; 100 is safe even for long responses.

laws_added: L70 GREETING_ONCE: agentGreetingSent flag prevents duplicate InjectAgentMessage on reconnect. Reset on WS drop.

errors_root_caused.root_cause: 0.85 speed with MP3 encoding produces audible artifacts on Deepgram TTS engine

errors_root_caused.error: Two OBIs speaking at once on boot
errors_root_caused.fix: agentGreetingSent guard + agentInjectInFlight silence timer guard + re-entrant playAgentChunk guard
errors_root_caused.root_cause: Race on SettingsApplied where duplicate Welcome triggers two InjectAgentMessages, compounded by silence timer firing during active response

errors_root_caused.fix: navigator.mediaDevices guard + 12s stale connection timeout in click handler
errors_root_caused.root_cause: getUserMedia rejection not caught in startAgentListening() auto-call path; WS-not-ready path in mic click handler had no timeout

errors_root_caused.error: Audio playback truncated mid-sentence for long responses
errors_root_caused.fix: Audio queue cap raised from 30 to 100; uniform cap checking across both push paths
errors_root_caused.root_cause: agentAudioQ.length < 30 check before accumulation but not before direct push of large chunks at line 1523
